The fixed circulation pump has an internal bearing/control failure; it is part of landlord-maintained equipment, outside ordinary small tenant maintenance. Normal ventilation and unobstructed radiators were observed; no tenant alteration or misuse explains the failure.","sha256":"a5e40553523e2dcee2df0f7f1acf40f8743fd93ff0260cf81ee3004ff78e8e1c","start_char":199,"text_sha256":"a5e40553523e2dcee2df0f7f1acf40f8743fd93ff0260cf81ee3004ff78e8e1c"}
